boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented library study environments spanning quiet floors, reservable rooms, computer-equipped areas, and a special-collections reading room.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library 2nd-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Evans 2nd-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 2nd floor
cards.notes: Use a first-come, first-served individual room when you need a quiet solo session; the floor has seven rooms designated for one person.
cards.short_summary: Seven first-come individual rooms for quiet, focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library's second floor has seven first-come, first-served individual study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Individual study rooms are for quiet study; library study rooms are available to current Texas A&M students, staff, and faculty.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library 3rd-Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Evans 3rd-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 3rd floor
cards.notes: Set up in the open quiet-study area, or reserve an individual room in advance when you want a more enclosed place to work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor combining open seating with reservable individual rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library's third floor is a quiet floor with open study space and 82 individual study rooms, all reservable.
cards.access_notes: Talking, calls, video chat, and speakers are not allowed in quiet spaces; individual rooms on Evans's third floor may be reserved up to a week ahead.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library 4th-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Evans 4th-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 4th floor
cards.notes: Choose an individual room for a self-directed work block; check the booking system for one of the 44 rooms available to reserve.
cards.short_summary: A large set of individual rooms, including 44 reservable options.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library's fourth floor has 72 individual study rooms, 44 of which are reservable.
cards.access_notes: Individual study rooms are intended for quiet work; confirm room availability through the Libraries reservation system.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library 5th-Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Evans 5th-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 5th floor
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or drafting to this open quiet floor, keeping calls, conversation, and audio outside the designated space.
cards.short_summary: Open study seating on Evans's fifth-floor quiet zone.
cards.evidence_claim: The fifth floor of Sterling C. Evans Library is a quiet floor with open study space.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, cell-phone use, video chat, and speakers.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library 1st-Floor Study Pods
cards.title: Evans 1st-Floor Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 1st floor
cards.notes: Use a freestanding pod when power at the desk matters; two of the three pods can be booked ahead through the Libraries system.
cards.short_summary: Freestanding study pods with desks, seating, and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library's first floor has three freestanding study pods; two are reservable and each includes seating, a desk, and power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Two of the three first-floor pods are reservable; check the Libraries booking system before relying on a specific pod.

cards.title: Evans Annex 5th-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Evans Library Annex · 5th floor
cards.notes: Work at an open-study seat on this quiet floor when you also need access to nearby OAL computers for software or printing tasks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet open study space paired with fifth-floor OAL computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The fifth floor of the Evans Annex is a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, calls, video chat, and speakers; the adjacent OAL listing identifies 42 fifth-floor computers.

cards.title: West Campus Library 3rd-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: West Campus Library · 3rd floor
cards.notes: Use the open quiet floor for concentrated coursework, with OAL computers available on the same floor for campus software and printing needs.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor with open seating and OAL computers.
cards.evidence_claim: West Campus Library's third floor is a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, calls, video chat, and speakers; the OAL listing reports 68 third-floor computers.

cards.title: West Campus Library 1st-Floor Study Pods
cards.subtitle: West Campus Library · 1st floor
cards.notes: Reserve one of the two first-floor pods when you want a defined small work setting rather than a seat in the open study area.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable study pods on West Campus Library's first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: West Campus Library's first floor has two reservable study pods.
cards.access_notes: Both listed first-floor study pods are reservable; use the Libraries booking system to confirm a time.

cards.title: Kelsey Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cushing Memorial Library & Archives · 2nd floor
cards.notes: Pair quiet study with archival research here; choose a seat in the reading room and use its OAL computers when your work calls for them.
cards.short_summary: A 38-seat reading room for quiet study and Cushing collections research.
cards.evidence_claim: Cushing's Kelsey Reading Room is available for collection researchers and quiet study and includes 38 seats and two OAL computers.
cards.access_notes: The room is on Cushing's second floor; quiet-space rules prohibit talking, calls, video chat, and speakers.

cards.title: Evans Graduate Writing Room
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library · 6th floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can use the dedicated writing room for quiet individual seating, especially when a collaborative lounge is not the right fit.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated quiet individual seating for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library's sixth-floor Graduate Writing Room is a quiet area with individual seating for graduate students.
cards.access_notes: This sixth-floor room is dedicated to graduate students; verify eligibility and current building access with the Libraries.
